points: FullStaQD project of Fraunhofer IAO, KIT and FZI, funded with about EUR 15m by the BMFTR
Three layers: applications, system functions and hardware
Open-source reference implementation planned for next year
take: A German blueprint to decouple quantum applications from specific hardware, reducing lock-in for early quantum pilots.
title: Fraunhofer IAO: first reference architecture for quantum software
